question: With which game is the Indian player R Vaishali associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chess**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• R Vaishali is an Indian chess player who has earned the titles of **International Master (IM)** and **Woman Grandmaster (WGM)**.
 
• She is the elder sister of Indian chess prodigy **R Praggnanandhaa**.
 
• Vaishali has represented India at numerous **international chess tournaments**, bringing accolades to the nation.
 
• In 2022, she won a bronze medal with the Indian team in the **Chess Olympiad** held in Chennai.
 
• Her achievements include winning the **World Youth Chess Championship** twice (Under-12 and Under-14 categories).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chess Terminologies:**

 
 
• **Grandmaster (GM):** The highest title awarded by FIDE, the international chess federation.
 
• **International Master (IM):** A title awarded to players below the level of Grandmaster but above other FIDE titles.
 
• **Woman Grandmaster (WGM):** The highest title exclusively for female chess players.
 
 
 
• **Chess Olympiad:**
 
 
• A biennial chess tournament where teams from different countries compete.
 
• India has been emerging as a strong contender in recent editions of the Olympiad.
 
 
 
• **Indian Chess Achievements:**
 
 
• India has produced several renowned players like **Viswanathan Anand**, the first Indian to become a Grandmaster.
 
• Indian chess players have consistently performed well at youth championships, Olympiads, and international events.
 
 
 
• **FIDE:**
 
 
• FIDE stands for Fédération Internationale des Échecs or International Chess Federation.
 
• It is the governing body of international chess competitions and awards titles like GM, IM, and WGM.
